title: Austin's Future: CodeNEXT, Housing & More
summary:
*   **CodeNEXT Future Sparks Heated Debate:** The council wrestled with extending a multi-million-dollar contract for the city's land development code rewrite (CodeNEXT), facing divided public opinion on its transparency, equity, effectiveness, and minority business participation.
*   **Major Affordable Housing Deal Approved:** A significant $2.065 million settlement for a housing complex passed, aimed at preserving affordability with loan repayment, rent credits, property repairs, and tenant protections.
*   **Boosting Minority Business & Police Oversight:** Directives were given to staff to boost minority and women-owned business (M/WBE) participation in city contracts. Discussions also emerged about auditing police department compliance with citizen review panel recommendations.

agenda_items.description: Approve an ordinance amending City Code Title 2 relating to the Municipal Court, the Downtown Austin Community Court, and the creation of a City Council Judicial Committee.
Approve a resolution relating to the contract for services at the Austin Resource Center for Homelessness.
Approve a resolution directing the City Manager to initiate a School-to-Prison Pipeline and Youth Justice Workgroup to create recommendations on non-criminal policies to support youth.

Approve a resolution initiating amendments to the regulating plan for the Plaza Saltillo Transit-Oriented Development Station Area, initiating neighborhood plan amendments and rezoning of the Housing Authority of the City of Austin Chalmers Courts property from multifamily residence moderate-high density (MF-4) district to transit-oriented district (TOD), and directing staff to assign the appropriate TOD subdistrict to bring back to council for action.
